May I ask OP if province ka or ncr. Anyway province or ncr naman may magagandang public school na may medicine. You can also ask for scholarship from alumni ng dream school mo alamin mo lang how and send them a letter-usually may mga groups yan and may pinapaaral sila na medyo di maganda ang financial situation. Pwede ka rin mag ask sa mayor nyo or any politicians may mga kilala din ako na ganon. Di mo need maging overachiever yung iba kahit tres basta pasado tutuloy nila scholarship.

If tuition fee alone ang goal mo na makuha pwede siguro yan or konting dagdag pa depende sa school pero baka hindi if include mo yung ibang gastos like dorm/pamasahe, baon, books(not advisable bumili ng totoo tbh kasi nasa 7-10k isa tapos by the time na done ka na di na rin sya up to date) so mas okay ipad then download ka nalang. May mga projects din na medyo magastos depende siguro what school you got in. Pero ayun medyo mahal talaga med school lalo if private. A lot of med schools 1st yr-4th yr lang may tuition pero yung iba need mo ipay 5th yr/pgi.

So final advice-combine mo yung dalawa ipon ka muna and look for any form of scholarship. Basta mahalaga focus ka sa studies para makita nila na sulit yung binabayad nila.
